guidelines.detail: refines GW-01 (The description explicitly allows either or both of the post-process actions, and F11 records a structural divergence at the reference inclusive gateway. GW-01 already calls for identifying inclusive behavior, while this guideline specifies when to use it.)
same as LRN-060 (The label pairs show generated labels substituting or altering described actions or outcomes. This guideline is already essentially stated by learned guideline LRN-060.)

refines LANE-01 (The description distinguishes player actions from bot work, while the records show that both corresponding lanes and activities were absent from the generated model. LANE-01 already advises using lanes for stated roles or systems; this guideline refines it for descriptions that distinguish human and automated responsibilities.)

same as LRN-062 (The description permits either or both follow-up actions, and the reference includes a flow from the completion decision to the action-choice gateway that is absent from the generated model. This supports modeling the optional combination and connecting the completion path to it. The learned guideline LRN-062 already covers modeling one or more selected optional actions with an inclusive gateway.)

same as LRN-060 (The label-pair records show semantic differences between generated labels and their reference matches, while the description provides the actions and outcomes needed to assess faithful wording. The proposed guideline is already stated essentially the same way in learned guideline LRN-060.)

same as LRN-063 (The description distinguishes the human choosing resources from the bot starting farming, and the records show the corresponding lanes and activities have no counterparts in the generated model. The wording is not tied to this process. LRN-063 already states essentially the same guideline.)

refines EVT-01 (The description places milestone notifications during the process, while the generated model uses a separate start event for a milestone. This refines the guidance on process start events by clarifying how to model a later trigger.)

same as LRN-060 (The label pairs show generated labels substituting or changing described actions, objects, or scope. This guideline matches learned guideline LRN-060, which already advises preserving the described action and object or result in labels.)

same as LRN-063 (The description assigns preference gathering to the player and farming to the bot, while the records show the corresponding lanes and activities have no counterparts in the generated model. This is already captured by learned guideline LRN-063.)

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description says that one or more of several optional actions may be selected, including that multiple actions may be performed together: Model the alternatives with an inclusive gateway so any nonempty combination of the actions can proceed.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description says that one or more of several optional actions may be selected, including that multiple actions may be performed together

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states a specific activity, decision, or outcome: Label the corresponding BPMN element with wording that preserves the described action and its object or result; do not substitute a related but different action or outcome.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states an activity or outcome

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description assigns work to both a human and an automated system within the same process: Represent each stated responsibility in the BPMN model, using lanes to distinguish the human and automated work and assigning activities to the appropriate lane.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description assigns work to both a human and an automated system within the same process

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states that a notification or milestone can occur after process work has begun: Model the later trigger within the ongoing process as an intermediate catch event, not as an independent process start event.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that a notification or milestone can occur after process work has begun
